entry.author: Whaikaha — Ministry of Disabled People
entry.summary:
Paula Tesoriero, Chief Executive of Whaikaha wanted to talk directly to you, after what has been a tough week for the community.

You can watch the video with NZSL and the option to turn captions on, there is also a transcript available: https://bit.ly/4a6U2W6

More information about the Purchasing Rules and Equipment Modification Services (EMS) changes can be found on our website: https://www.whaikaha.govt.nz/news-and-events/news/whaikaha-purchasing-rules-and-equipment-and-modification-services-ems-update
